Subject: Update README.md and package-lock.json

Armando di Filippo has been added to the README.md file, providing information about his education, experience, courses taught, publications, and contact information. Additionally, the package-lock.json file has been updated with new dependencies including "react-ip" and "asn1.js" along with their respective versions.

Contact form functionality improvements

The Contact component has been updated to improve the functionality of the contact form. The `@emailjs/browser` library is now imported with `init` and `send` methods only, while the `sendForm` method is no longer imported.

Within the Contact component, the handleSubmit function has been updated to use async/await syntax. The templateParams object is now created inside the handleSubmit function. The serviceId, templateId, and templateParams variables are extracted from the process.env.REACT_APP_API_EMAILJS_* environment variables.

Additionally, the component now sets the state of the contactForm object to empty values after a successful form submission. A success alert is also displayed to notify users that the form has been successfully submitted.

These changes improve the overall functionality and user experience of the contact form in the Contact component.

feat: Add new environment variables for EmailJS API

Add new environment variables for the EmailJS API key and service ID to the `.env` file. This includes the public and private keys for two different email accounts and the service ID.

Update the `App.js` file.

Add VCS Git configuration and update dependencies

This update includes adding a vcs.xml file for VCS Git configuration settings. The .gitignore file was modified to include the .env option. The package-lock.json was updated with new packages as well as updates to existing ones, providing critical module updates and enhanced application functionality.
Initialize project using Create React App
"Added AvatarForm and corresponding view for avatar upload, updated register.html template to include file input for avatar upload"

Add Avatar model and update UploadExcel form

The Avatar model has been added to `models.py` to manage user avatar images. This includes a new migration file (`0002_avatar.py`). In `forms.py`, a label and requirement have been added to the file upload in the UploadExcel form. Also, a new field 'exclude' is added to exclude 'user'.

Add functionality to upload Excel files

The commit introduces functionality for authenticated users to upload Excel files. Changes are made across numerous files: a new form, view, url path and template have been introduced for handling the Excel file upload. The uploaded Excel data is used to create 'Record' instances which are then saved to the database.

Add README.md with project description and tech stack

A new README.md file has been added providing a detailed description about the CRM Inmobiliario project, mentioning its main features and functionalities. The file has also included the list of technologies or tech stack used in the development of this project.

Add CRM record management features

Implemented a feature to manage CRM records which includes creation, deletion, and updating of records. Added new, edit and delete routes, created UIs and forms for these operations, and updated views to handle these actions. Also displayed all the records on the homepage.

Add new Django models, views, and templates for CRM app

This commit introduces a new "Record" model for the CRM app, along with associated views and templates for user authentication and registration. Templates for the homepage, base page, navbar, and registration page have been created. Various settings and configuration files have also been added.

Add 'About Me' section and improve NavBar

Enhanced the Navigation Bar by adding Image support and improved the design using CSS. A new 'About Me' section has been added to provide additional information about the site owner, including a personal introduction and skillset. Additionally, unnecessary font styles have been removed.

Update README with portfolio details

The README.md file has been overhauled to replace the previous Next.js setup instructions with information about the portfolio web page. This includes background on the technologies used, setup instructions, and key features. The introduction now provides a personalized welcome from the project owner.

Add Heroicons library and customize UI

Added "@heroicons/react" dependency in package.json and package-lock.json. Customized the HeroSection and NavBar components for better user interface with updated styling and new animations. Also, integrated a new font 'Mona-Sans' and changes applied in CSS files.

Add deployment, prettier, vcs XML files and refactor home page

A significant refactor has been made to the home page allowing for cleaner, more manageable components. Additionally, deployment.xml, prettier.xml, and vcs.xml files have been added to .idea. Also, "react-type-animation" is now a project dependency, which is included in `HeroSection` component.

Initialize Rust project to read CPU temperature on macOS

This commit sets up a new Rust project named "temp_read_macos". The project includes a main.rs source file that contains the code for reading CPU temperature on macOS systems. Along with the key project files, Gitignore files for both the project root and .idea directories were created to ignore non-essential files generated by the Rust compiler and IntelliJ IDEA.
